budget_note: both arms keep a subset of the frozen Production tickets (no MEC rebuild), so investment is always <= Production; report PFS, PFS excl. max payout, net profit change and investment change together.

arms.rule: frozen Production tickets minus every TRIFECTA ticket; a race whose tickets are all TRIFECTA becomes no-bet
arms.metric: net profit change vs frozen Production tickets; PFS and PFS excl. max payout
arms.promote_if: at 300R net profit change > 0, PFS excl. max payout not lower than Production, venue_rule == CONSISTENT_IMPROVEMENT -> Owner decision
arms.reject_if: at 100R net profit change < 0 (the dropped TRIFECTA paid more than it cost)

arms.rule: frozen Production EXACTA tickets only (TRIFECTA and TRIO dropped)
arms.metric: net profit change vs Production AND vs DROP_TRIFECTA (credits dropping TRIO separately)
arms.promote_if: at 300R beats Production and DROP_TRIFECTA on net profit and PFS excl. max payout, venue_rule == CONSISTENT_IMPROVEMENT -> Owner decision
arms.reject_if: at 100R not better than DROP_TRIFECTA on net profit
